_comment: Geometry of one stop-and-go wave in lane 1, read off the time-space
t_offset is subtracted from the UTC timestamps so the wave and platoon
points below can be written as readable seconds-into-the-recording.
1669120000.0 is 2022-11-22 06:26:40 Central, i.e. 27 minutes into the
06:00 recording. The platoon below spans 06:27:09 to 06:29:44 Central.
wave: two points on the wave front. Their slope is the wave speed, which
sets the slant of one edge of every parallelogram.
platoon: successive points along ONE platoon's path through the wave, in
order. Each becomes a parallelogram whose other edge follows the local
vehicle trajectory. Aggregating Edie's quantities over these slanted
regions rather than rectangles is what makes the hysteresis loop resolve.
half_space_veh: half-extent of each parallelogram along the vehicle
direction, in feet. half_time_wave: half-extent along the wave direction,
in seconds. Together they set how much data each point averages over.
